court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: Naresh, Director of Elementary Education, DPI Campus, Chennai and Others

Contempt petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, seeking to punish the respondents for wilful disobedience of the order dated 01.09.2025 passed by this Court in W.P. No. 32939 of 2025
advocates: For Respondents: Mrs. P. Rajarajeswari, GA
judgment_text:
ORDER

This contempt petition has been filed seeking to punish the respondents for wilful disobedience of the order dated 1-9-2025 passed by this Court in W.P. No. 32939 of 2025.

2. Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, learned government advocate appearing for the respondents submitted that, the order under contempt has been complied with and she also produced the copy of the proceedings dated 27-1-2026 and 16-2-2026 to that effect.

3. In view of the above submission made by the learned government advocate, this contempt petition stands closed.
